SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] "It's not the art of loving that's hard, but the art of 
being loved."

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] - Alphonse Daudet

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] This is the Kousaka household, located somewhere 
in Chiba.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] In this residence, worried maidens assemble, 
seeking answers from the master of life, every night.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Now then, I wonder who tonight's guest will be...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Come in...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] E-Excuse me.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Who goes there?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Eeek!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] M-My apologies for the late introduction. I am Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Um, I heard that if I were to come here, I could 
take part in a life consultation.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Correct. This place exists to show the way to lost 
youths like you.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] In here, hold nothing back, just say whatever you 
want.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] In return, I will not hold back either.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Ugh... The mere thought of having a consultation 
with you is terrifying, Uncle.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Who are you calling Uncle? Address me by Sensei.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yes, Sensei...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] U-Umm... I have something to consult with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] W-Well... Lately, I've been constantly tuned out.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Tuned out...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] As a representative for otaku...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] I have done well to be able to showcase the best 
of what a work has to offer. Surely!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] And yet... the plot thickens without my knowledge, 
and sometimes whole problems get resolved while 
I'm told what happens afterwards...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] I believe this is definitely due to my unexpected 
lack of life experience.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] And I'm just a timid, ordinary super-cute lady, 
which led to that happening.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] H-Hmm...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Naturally, I heard I'm able to appear as such in 
this game, so I was pleased. Enough to run laps 
around town.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] But, since I'm like that... I can't help but get 
embarrassed in front of others...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] I wanted to take the reins of the story but... for 
someone like me...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I see... It seems you have plenty to worry about. By 
the way...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] What does "tuned out" mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Eh...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I've read newspapers but, I can't keep up with all 
the words the youth uses these days.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...Is this person really qualified to be a sensei?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] What?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] N-No, nothing...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] While it may be arrogant of me to explain... being 
tuned out means, getting passed by-

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] In this case, ignoring me and progressing the story, 
Sensei.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm... And to you, it's unforgivable.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] "Unforgivable"... is going a bit too far, but I'm 
frustrated by it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] I've been granted the ability of the Joker card and 
yet... the story advances without a chance for me to 
demonstrate it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] I'm not limited to just being the character that 
defuses heated arguments by pouring water onto 
people, you know?!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Is that all you have to say, little girl?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Eh...!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Hmm, if you ask me, that's not even worth worrying 
about...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Being tuned out, doesn't that mean you have some 
underlying issues already?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] W-Well...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Look at this.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] What is this? A mountain of magazines...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] My daughter is featur- *cough*  I mean, I love to 
read them.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] There's this passage here. Read it.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Special Feature, "What Men Often See in Annoying 
Women"...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=28]Wha---[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Point one, "A constantly passive woman".

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ughhh...!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Point two, "Looks away without making eye 
contact".

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Gahhh...!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Point three, "Too docile in conversations, only 
responding with hmms or ahhs, nothing of 
substance".

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Eeeek!!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Finally... [font_size=28]"Always talks about herself as if 
she wants someone to comfort her"[/font_size]!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] A-Ahhhh...AHHHHHHHH...!!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] P-Please stop... I... might not be able to recover from 
this...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...It looks like it struck a nerve.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Yes... It's exactly as you say, I am just riddled with 
many problems...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] I knew it deep down already, someone like me just 
isn't capable of taking the reins of a story...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's not true.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Eh...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] If you hate being tuned out, then make it so they 
can't tune you out.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] H-How would I...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'll give you a piece of advice.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Advice- Don't tell me, you're gonna recommend the 
spiral glasses too...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Spiral glasses? What is that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] N-Nothing, I was talking to myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Anyway... For starters, why not try training your 
body?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] That way, when people get ahead of themselves, 
you can send them into oblivion with one strike.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] N-No way... I could never do something so dreadful...!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I mean, the yandere role is already filled-

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I'm not telling you to actually murder people! You 
fool!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] What I mean is, have some dignity!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...Dignity...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] It's a technique often used against suspects who 
stay silent.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] By having both a body and nerves of steel, others 
will have the impression, "No way I can beat this 
person".

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] If you do that, everyone else will have no choice 
but to take notice of you.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] O-Okay...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Training the body will train the mind... A trained 
body without the need for weapons or tools is 
where true strength lies.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] If I were to use one of the slang from youth like 
you, you would be OP! Something like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Seize the opportunity, aim for being truly OP!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] What I lack, is dignity...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] To be truly OP...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I-I understand!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I will go straight home and start working out!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yes, a wise decision.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Thank you, Sensei!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I will call you master #2 from now on!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Well then, excuse me.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Mmm... she left.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Today's moral lesson!!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=30]Before becoming afraid of others, you 
should first train yourself!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] And so, Daisuke has guided the path of another lost 
maiden. Let us meet on another moonlit night.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Your advice today was really magnificent, darling.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Master #2... I'm not the first then...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] ...You gave such a splendid suggestion, yet you're 
fussing about that?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Mmm...
